topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The morning held a surprise under the once familiar shade. The tree, my silent companion since childhood, now leaves an open canvas of sky. Yet, in its absence, a new invitation to look up and see the shapes of clouds, to trace the paths of birds in flight. The spot where roots once anchored themselves deep now whispers of possibilities, urging me to plant anew, to watch growth from another beginning. There’s a lightness, a fresh start in the air, and the sun seems to beam down, brighter than before.
